profile.headline: Software Developer Specialist 3 at BYU Enterprise Solutions Group
profile.summary: Software Engineer with thorough hand on experience in all levels of testing, including functional, integration, regression testing.  Team player dedicated to streamlining processes and efficiently resolving project issues.

positions.title: Software Developer Specialist 3
positions.description:
• Demonstrated proficiency in JavaScript, Typescript, Angular, PHP, and MYSQL, contributing to the development of web

applications by over 50%.
